title: Financial vs Physical Progress Review
description: Review when financial utilization runs substantially ahead of reported physical progress.

steps.title: Quantify the gap
steps.guidance: Review the utilization percentage against reported physical progress and the size of the gap from the risk factor evidence.

steps.title: Verify physical progress
steps.guidance: Request the latest measurement-book entries, inspection reports, or site photographs to verify the reported physical progress.

steps.title: Check for front-loaded material procurement
steps.guidance: Some works legitimately incur early expenditure (material procurement, mobilization advances). Confirm whether documented advances explain the gap.

steps.title: Record a conclusion with reasons
steps.guidance: State whether the gap is explained (advances, reporting lag) or the project requires enhanced monitoring/escalation.
